text: I will send the finished opening animation, including the painted title sequence, to the producer on Thursday.
The opening animation now has its final color palette. Our studio will deliver the rendered sequence and matching stills tomorrow afternoon.
I expect to deliver the opening animation on Thursday, provided the final character poses are approved.
Please send the finished opening animation to the producer on Thursday. Include the painted title sequence in the export.
I guarantee that the facilities office will receive my boiler inspection certificate by noon tomorrow.
The pressure tests are complete. Our maintenance team will place the signed boiler inspection certificate in the facilities register tomorrow morning.
I should have the boiler inspection certificate ready tomorrow, assuming the pressure gauge passes its calibration check.
I filed the boiler inspection certificate yesterday. The facilities register already contains the signed copy and the pressure readings.
I will deliver the bakery's revised sourdough production sheet to the night shift before tonight's mixing begins.
The revised sheet separates starter refreshments from final dough mixing. Our bakery team will place printed copies at every mixing station this evening.
I intend to deliver the revised sourdough production sheet tonight, though the fermentation timings are still provisional.
Please put the revised sourdough production sheet at every mixing station tonight. Make the starter refreshment times easy to find.
I will deliver the bound harbor fender replacement drawings to the marine contractor on Wednesday morning.
The harbor drawings specify the bolt spacing for each fender. Our engineering office will supply the contractor with the bound replacement set on Wednesday.
Please deliver the bound harbor fender replacement drawings to the marine contractor before Wednesday's site meeting.
The harbor fender drawings show three mounting arrangements. I will not issue a replacement set during this maintenance cycle.
Our bookbinding workshop will return the repaired atlas with its new linen spine on Friday.
The atlas now has reinforced endpapers. I will deliver the repaired volume and its protective slipcase to the map room on Friday afternoon.
The workshop proprietor said that her binders would return the repaired atlas with its new linen spine on Friday.
I returned the repaired atlas on Friday afternoon. Its linen spine and protective slipcase were inspected at the map room desk.
I will send the urban orchard coordinator a tree pruning diagram for every courtyard by tomorrow.
The courtyard diagrams identify fruiting wood and crossing branches. Our arboriculture team will deliver the complete pruning diagram pack tomorrow afternoon.
We hope to deliver the courtyard pruning diagrams tomorrow, provided the remaining pear trees can be inspected today.
Please send the orchard coordinator a pruning diagram for each courtyard. Mark crossing branches separately from healthy fruiting wood.
I will give the public swimming pool manager the completed lane rope replacement inventory tomorrow.
The inventory distinguishes cracked floats from damaged tensioners. Our pool maintenance team will send the manager the completed lane rope replacement inventory tomorrow afternoon.
Would you give the swimming pool manager a completed inventory of replacement lane rope floats and tensioners?
I am not issuing a lane rope replacement inventory tomorrow. The pool manager already has the inventory completed during last month's closure.
Our court interpretation office will provide the training coordinator with the fictional hearing glossary next Wednesday.
The practice hearing uses invented names and a fictional dispute. I will send the training coordinator the finished interpretation glossary and exercise notes on Wednesday.
Could you provide the training coordinator with the fictional hearing glossary before next Wednesday's interpretation workshop?
The interpretation trainer said she would supply the fictional hearing glossary next Wednesday. I recorded her statement alongside the workshop agenda.
Our canal maintenance team will deliver the lock gate seal replacement kit to the eastern depot tomorrow.
The replacement kit contains cut seals and labeled fastening strips. I will bring the complete lock gate kit to the eastern depot tomorrow morning.
Could you deliver the complete lock gate seal replacement kit to the eastern maintenance depot tomorrow?
The canal workshop foreman said his team would deliver the lock gate seal kit tomorrow. I entered that statement in the depot's incoming equipment log.
I will send the poetry publisher the finished bilingual chapbook page proofs before Thursday's editorial meeting.
The facing pages keep each poem beside its translation. Our typesetting studio will deliver the complete bilingual chapbook proofs to the publisher on Wednesday evening.
Please send the poetry publisher the finished bilingual chapbook page proofs before Thursday's editorial meeting.
The bilingual chapbook page proofs reached the publisher yesterday evening. I supplied the complete set with the poems and translations on facing pages.
